name: comp-158

frames.best_why: Seven colour rings show the third filled as a white disc with a dot, and no cursor covers them.

tagline: Pick one colour from a row of bright rings.
summary: A single-choice row of seven coloured rings that lets someone choose an accent colour. The chosen ring becomes a white disc with a dark dot while the others stay hollow.
appearance: Under a bold "Choose a color" legend, seven evenly spaced rings sit on a near-black stage in blue, indigo, pink, red, orange, amber and emerald. The selected ring turns into a solid white disc with a small dark dot at its centre.
behaviour: Clicking a ring makes it the only white disc and empties the previous choice back to a thin coloured outline; hovering a ring glows its edge. Only one colour can be active at a time.
use_when: A settings or label form needs a quick single colour choice from a small fixed palette.
avoid_when: Seven hue classes are hardcoded and blue starts selected, so custom brand colours mean editing every item.
customise: No props: each of the seven swatches and its colour class is written out, so adding a hue or recolouring one means editing every item.
weight_why: Seven small radio dots with fixed colours; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Every swatch carries a colour name label and the group is keyboard navigable, but the choice is shown by white fill alone.

issues: The selected swatch turns white, so the colour actually chosen is hidden.
polish_why: Even, vivid swatch row; turning the chosen ring white hides which colour is picked.
